info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-Delete Investment Portfolio Withdraw-v3-spec
info.description: This API enables the management of investment portfolio withdrawal transactions. Through this endpoint, users can delete specific withdrawal records associated with their investment portfolios. Typical consumers include financial institutions, investment platforms, and personal finance applications looking to maintain accurate records of their client transactions. The API ensures streamlined handling of withdrawal requests, allowing for efficient updates to portfolio statuses in response to user actions.

delete.description: This operation allows users to withdraw funds from their investment portfolio, effectively liquidating a portion of their assets as per their request. Upon successful withdrawal, the specified amount will be deducted from the user's portfolio balance.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the withdrawal details for the portfolio. It should include all necessary parameters required to process the withdrawal request.

202.description: The request has been accepted and is being processed.

DeleteInvestmentPortfolioWithdrawRequest.description: Request body for DELETE operations regarding withdraw portfolio. This represents a confirmation or details string for the withdrawal operation.

status.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number associated with the withdrawal operation.

resultId.description: An identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: The current state of the withdrawal operation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the operation in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional details about the operation.

DeleteInvestmentPortfolioWithdrawRespons.description: This schema represents the response structure for the DELETE operation on portfolio withdrawal.

createdBy.description: The user who created the withdrawal operation.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the withdrawal operation was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the operation was automated.

AuditDetails.description: Details about the audit information related to the withdrawal operation.

x-processing-time.description: The time taken to process the request, measured in milliseconds. A value of 0 indicates that the request was processed instantaneously.
